controls.title: KDF parameters remain within approved bounds
Unknown, oversized, nested, bulk, and wallet-shaped input is rejected
Reports expose no fixture credential or wallet-shaped material
Production source contains no VaultLab import, fixture, or credential marker
Security agents return recommendations without execution authority
Security events reject commands, transactions, targets, and credential material
Evidence envelopes bind a passing report to an exact source revision
Signing-intent policy accepts sanitized classifications and rejects transaction or secret material
Signing-intent decisions require a human and never grant signing or execution authority
Recovery requires independent legal, security, and custody approval
Recovery transitions preserve authority, approvals, waiting policy, notifications, and finding gates
Native-custody readiness requires all twelve controls and zero critical or high findings
Native-custody assessment is staging-only and cannot activate deployment, signing, or asset movement
